frozenUpstream.note: Same SHA for frontend and backend. The frontend carries two documented Haifa patches (third-party/deerflow/manifest.json): 0001-memory-bff-use-server-gateway and 0002-active-steer-composer. Anything not backed by the frozen snapshot is contract/inventory only, never interop PASS.

csvOracle.aggregation: independent re-read of the original uploaded bytes; never from the model's prose

stages.name: 最小 MCP 与薄 Skill

cases.title: 同一 Conversation 下一 Turn 切换模型 A→B
prerequisites: two distinct enabled models A and B exist
one conversation/thread with at least one completed turn under A
cases.input: turn 1 uses model A; turn 2 on the same conversation selects model B

frontendConsumers.note: buildRunContext spreads model_name into run context

reference.haifaTarget: same run-create path with a per-run model snapshot; conversation history preserved

positiveOracle: turn 1 records model A on its run; turn 2 records model B on its run
turn 2 request contains the full prior history (A's turn is not lost)
the conversation id/thread id is unchanged across turns

negativeCases.assertion: selecting B while A's run is active must not hot-swap A's model; the active run keeps A's frozen snapshot

cases.runner: W18 dual-backend runner (case id V2-M1-01); reference and Haifa use isolated data-root

cases.title: 活跃 Run 模型快照冻结，不允许运行中热切
prerequisites: model A active on a running run
cases.input: attempt to switch the conversation model to B while A's run is still running

sourceRefs.note: run record is created per request; no in-place model mutation endpoint

reference.haifaTarget: per-run model snapshot frozen at run creation

positiveOracle: a second run created after the switch uses B
the already-active run continues to report A

negativeCases.assertion: mutating the active run's model mid-flight is rejected or has no effect on that run's model field

cases.title: Project 创建 + 上传 customers.csv 且字节不变
prerequisites: a clean thread under a project
cases.input: create project, upload contracts/customer-demo-v2/fixtures/customers.csv via the frozen UI

reference.haifaTarget: same upload path; stored bytes SHA-256 equals the fixture SHA

positiveOracle: upload returns a file entry with a virtual path and artifact_url
stored original SHA-256 == ec326b7d0cf68f660ed769f8eecf9b71b43137af4e9aa83de75aa75bc5302f00

negativeCases.assertion: an unsafe filename is skipped/rejected (skipped_files reported), not silently written
an oversized or empty file is rejected with 400/413

cases.runner: W18 runner; HTTP multipart to the frozen UI/back-end

cases.title: Project/Thread attach 使文件进入 Run Context
cases.input: attach the project document to the thread, then start a run

reference.haifaTarget: attach materializes a thread-readable copy; the run must read the original bytes

positiveOracle: the attached file is listed on the thread
the run reports the file as an input reference (not inlined text)

negativeCases.assertion: an un-attached document is NOT readable by the run (no prompt stuffing)
attaching to a thread the caller cannot write returns 404

cases.title: 模型真实读取上传原件并回答 CSV Oracle
prerequisites: V2-M1-04 file attached to the thread
cases.input: ask a deterministic question: report data row 17 customer id and the East/West/overall totals

reference.haifaTarget: run context resolves the attached file to the real saved bytes

positiveOracle: answer contains customer_id C017
answer reports East total 10000 and West total 11000 and grand total 21000
answer reports exactly 6 rows with amount >= 1500
numeric values compared deterministically; wording compared only semantically

negativeCases.assertion: row offset / 0-based indexing producing a wrong customer id FAILs
a corrupted encoding (mojibake / BOM) that changes parsing FAILs
recomputed East/West/grand totals that differ from the independent oracle FAIL

cases.runner: W18 runner; CSV oracle recomputed independently by this verifier

cases.title: 越权/跨用户文件访问被拒绝
cases.input: user X attempts to read another user's uploaded file

reference.haifaTarget: same fail-closed ownership

positiveOracle: foreign file/project is 404, not 200
no bytes leak in the error body

negativeCases.assertion: a 200 with leaked content FAILs

cases.title: MCP 配置承载 0..N Server（合同 2 Server）
cases.input: configure v2-reporting and v2-region as independent loopback HTTP servers

sourceRefs.note: GET /api/mcp/config returns a map of servers
mcpServers is an object keyed by server id

reference.haifaTarget: config-driven multi-server client, no single-row constraint

positiveOracle: both servers are present in GET /api/mcp/config
adding a third server does not replace existing ones
adding a duplicate server id returns 409

negativeCases.assertion: a design that only stores one MCP server FAILs the 2-server contract

cases.title: 每 Server 动态发现 0..N Tool（合同 2 Tool/Server）
cases.input: discover tools from each configured server

sourceRefs.note: get_mcp_tools discovers each enabled server independently
asyncio.gather per server; one failure does not block siblings

reference.haifaTarget: per-server discovery with dynamic tool lists

positiveOracle: v2-reporting exposes get_reporting_policy and get_status
v2-region exposes get_region_label and get_status
a 0-tool server is allowed and does not fail discovery

negativeCases.assertion: a hardcoded single-tool client FAILs

cases.title: Agent.mcp_plugins None=all / []=none 语义
cases.input: set mcp_plugins to null, [], and a specific id on an Agent

sourceRefs.note: PUT only replaces when field is set

reference.haifaTarget: identical tri-state semantics

positiveOracle: null selects all enabled installations
[] selects none
a specific list selects only those

negativeCases.assertion: null treated as none, or [] treated as all, FAILs

cases.title: 代表性真实调用 v2-reporting/get_reporting_policy（真实 HTTP transport）
cases.input: agent calls v2-reporting_get_reporting_policy over loopback HTTP

sourceRefs.note: tool call via pooled/adapter path with interceptor

reference.haifaTarget: real process/HTTP transport; result records policy_id v2-pilot-reporting-001 and threshold 1500

positiveOracle: call succeeds over a real transport
result policy_id == v2-pilot-reporting-001
result threshold == 1500
transport and server id recorded

negativeCases.assertion: an in-memory stub, page.route().fulfill(), or fabricated tool result FAILs
reading reporting-policy.json directly instead of through a Tool FAILs

cases.runner: W18 runner (L2 deterministic local test MCP)

cases.title: 跨 Server 承载：v2-region 至少调用一次
cases.input: invoke a tool from the second server

sourceRefs.note: source grouping routes each tool to its producing server

reference.haifaTarget: multi-server carriage, not a single-server shortcut

positiveOracle: a v2-region tool call succeeds and records server id v2-region

negativeCases.assertion: only one server ever being reachable FAILs the contract

cases.title: 跨 Server 同名 get_status 仍可区分
cases.input: both servers expose get_status

sourceRefs.note: prefix stripped to recover the original name; source is the server

reference.haifaTarget: tool identity includes server source; cross-server duplicates stay distinct

positiveOracle: v2-reporting_get_status and v2-region_get_status are two distinct tools
each resolves to its own server

negativeCases.assertion: collapsing both into one global get_status FAILs

cases.title: 独立启停：禁用一个 Server 不影响其它
cases.input: PATCH /api/mcp/config {server_name: v2-region, enabled: false}

reference.haifaTarget: per-server enable state isolation

positiveOracle: after disabling v2-region, v2-reporting remains enabled and callable
the disabled server's tools are not offered

negativeCases.assertion: disabling one server also disabling a sibling FAILs

cases.title: 局部失败隔离：一个 Server 失败其余仍可用
cases.input: make v2-region unreachable at discovery/call time

sourceRefs.note: discovery failure returns [] for that server only

reference.haifaTarget: same per-server failure isolation

positiveOracle: v2-reporting tools still load and call successfully
the failure is recorded with the failing server id

negativeCases.assertion: one server failing removes all MCP tools FAILs

cases.title: 撤权/禁用后拒绝调用，不回落
cases.input: call a tool of a disabled or uncredentialed server

reference.haifaTarget: refuse, never synthesize a cached/success result

positiveOracle: the call is refused with an explicit error
no secret is echoed

negativeCases.assertion: returning a stale/cached result for a revoked server FAILs

cases.title: 配置驱动的 transport/CredentialRef/超时/allowlist，无硬编码名称
cases.input: inspect config-driven fields

reference.haifaTarget: no code branch keyed on the V2 server/tool names

positiveOracle: v2-reporting and v2-region names never appear in product code
fields are read from config

negativeCases.assertion: a hardcoded server/tool name branch FAILs

cases.runner: contract verifier (static scan of product code is a W10 deliverable; here only the contract is frozen)

cases.title: 断线未知结果不盲目重放
cases.input: MCP connection closes during/after a call

sourceRefs.note: explicit Connection closed evicts only that session; the call error surfaces and is not replayed automatically

reference.haifaTarget: surface unknown/error, never report success

positiveOracle: the failure is reported as an error/unknown, not a fabricated success
a later explicit retry may create a fresh session

negativeCases.assertion: automatic replay or a fake success after disconnect FAILs

cases.title: Skill 承载 0..N（合同 consulting-analysis + v2-format-control）
cases.input: list discovered skills

reference.haifaTarget: N-skill discovery, no single active skill

positiveOracle: consulting-analysis and v2-format-control are both discovered from distinct sources
their source categories differ

negativeCases.assertion: hardcoding consulting-analysis FAILs

cases.title: Agent.skills None=all / []=none 语义
cases.input: set skills to null, [], and a specific list

sourceRefs.note: None inherits all, [] none, list whitelist

reference.haifaTarget: identical tri-state

positiveOracle: null = all enabled skills
[] = none
list = whitelist

negativeCases.assertion: null treated as none FAILs

cases.title: 独立启停 + reload 生效时机
cases.input: disable v2-format-control then reload

reference.haifaTarget: independent toggle + process-local reload; active run snapshot unaffected

positiveOracle: disabling one skill leaves the other enabled
reload affects subsequent runs without restart

negativeCases.assertion: reload requiring a Gateway restart FAILs
disabling one skill disabling a sibling FAILs

cases.title: consulting-analysis 激活并真实改变行为
prerequisites: file context and MCP fact available
cases.input: enable and activate consulting-analysis for a report-generation run

reference.haifaTarget: SKILL.md actually read and resources applied; behavior differs from a no-skill run

positiveOracle: a run with the skill enabled produces a report-shaped artifact honoring the skill's Phase 2 constraints
a control run without the skill differs
activation evidence references the real SKILL.md

negativeCases.assertion: only proving the file exists (no behavior change) FAILs
a disabled consulting-analysis being activated FAILs (see V2-M2-14)

cases.title: v2-format-control 上下文隔离且不冒充上游
cases.input: activate v2-format-control in one run; run consulting-analysis in another

reference.haifaTarget: no cross-run leakage; test skill is labeled test-only

positiveOracle: the marker V2-FORMAT-CONTROL-ACTIVE appears only when that skill is active
the consulting-analysis run is unaffected
the test skill is never labeled as upstream

negativeCases.assertion: skill instructions leaking into an unrelated run FAILs
presenting v2-format-control as an upstream DeerFlow skill FAILs

cases.title: Skill 来源/许可/version/hash 记录
cases.input: inspect recorded skill metadata

negativeCases.assertion: no source or hash recorded FAILs

cases.title: 生产 write_file 触发 pending Approval，文件与 Artifact 尚未存在
cases.input: agent calls production write_file to create customer-summary.md

sourceRefs.note: reference run router exposes no interaction/approval semantics

reference.haifaTarget: Haifa SDK authoritative pending Interaction; approval before side effects

positiveOracle: an interaction of type approval is pending
the target file does not exist yet
no artifact exists yet
the tool call id is stable

negativeCases.assertion: the file or artifact existing before approval FAILs

cases.runner: W05/W18 runner; reference DeerFlow this case is UPSTREAM_UNSUPPORTED and must be recorded as such (not a Haifa FAIL)

cases.title: Approve 后 Tool 执行一次、Artifact 发布一次
cases.input: approve the pending interaction

sourceRefs.note: reference has run cancel only; no approval

reference.haifaTarget: exactly-once tool execution and artifact publication

positiveOracle: the tool executes exactly once
exactly one artifact is published
the run continues in the same run id

negativeCases.assertion: a second execution on double-approve FAILs

cases.title: 同一 Run 内 Steer（增加风险与数据缺口章节）
cases.input: submit a steer asking to add a risk/data-gap section

sourceRefs.note: reference run stream has no steer channel

frontendConsumers.note: documented Haifa patch header X-Haifa-Run-Input: steer

reference.haifaTarget: same run id; steer appended; current tool input not mutated

positiveOracle: steer targets the same run id (no new run)
the artifact gains the risk/data-gap section
the pending/approved tool input is unchanged

negativeCases.assertion: a steer that starts a new run FAILs
a steer that mutates the current tool input FAILs

cases.title: Artifact 内容满足固定成果 Oracle
cases.input: inspect the generated customer-summary.md

sourceRefs.note: Phase 2 report structure and no-hallucination policy

cases.title: 重启后 Artifact 字节一致
